lessonsIntro: We have not confirmed a surf school that teaches in Redcar itself. The nearest schools are a few miles down the coast in Saltburn.

text: Redcar has a long sandy seafront, but we could not find a surf school that teaches here on any official or business website. If you want to learn, the closest confirmed lessons are at Saltburn, where Saltburn Surf School and Flow Surf School both teach beginners on the gentler waves by the pier.

Redcar's breaks include reefs (scars) that are better known to experienced local surfers than to learners. Without a school or confirmed lifeguard information to go on, we suggest you take your first lessons at Saltburn and only surf Redcar once you can read the conditions yourself.

hireIntro: We have not confirmed surf hire in Redcar; Saltburn Surf School hires a full range a short drive away.

text: The beaches on this stretch are mostly sandy beach breaks, so a long foam board is the right start, moving on to a hard mini-mal or longboard as you improve. Scarborough Surf School hires only 5/4mm wetsuits because the North Sea stays cold, and adds boots, gloves and hoods for the cooler months.

cards.label: Board
cards.title: Soft-top for learners
cards.text: Beginners should stick to a large foam board on sandy sections and leave the reefs to experienced surfers.

cards.label: Wetsuit
cards.title: 5/4mm most of the year
cards.text: North Sea water stays cool. Scarborough Surf School hires only 5/4mm suits and treats them as year-round wear, adding boots, gloves and a hood in the colder months.

cards.label: Other craft
cards.title: Bodyboard on sand
cards.text: Bodyboarding is best kept to sandy, patrolled beaches; hire is available in Saltburn.

shopsText: We have not found a surf shop in Redcar. Saltburn, a few miles south, has Drift Surf Shop and Saltburn Surf School, which sell boards, wetsuits and accessories, including second-hand kit.
